text:
morgan: Heads-up 1 - customer reported duplicate billing during a streaming toolcall retry after KV eviction. Console shows a provisional row that never tombstoned and a later confirmed row from the retry.

morgan: Minimal logs:
```
2026-04-18T15:42:01Z stream=s-19 provisional=92 kv_evicted=true reconnect=true
2026-04-18T15:42:03Z client_retry req=r-19 confirm=184 origin=retry
```

tara: Oof. Did the truncation path emit an abort/tombstone? We have seen the abort hook lose to the error-return path.

leo: Looks like an ordering race. Abort isn't always persisted before the response. Two fix options: 1) force abort persistence on error path (adds latency) 2) make confirm path merge/consume overlapping provisionals.

anika: I prefer merge-on-confirm as defense-in-depth to avoid changing hot-path latency. But we need a stable join key across reconnects. session_id alone is ambiguous, client_trace can rotate.

morgan: Proposal: introduce x-origin-id emitted at session creation and carried through reconnects. Confirm writer will try to join on (x-origin-id, seq_range) and atomically mark provisionals confirmed. If x-origin-id absent, fall back to best-effort heuristics.

tara: Important: add a concurrent composite index on (origin_id, seq_start) before enabling merge to prevent confirmation latency spikes. DB team sign-off needed.

leo: Also add a reconciliation job that scans confirmed rows with overlapping provisionals older than 5m and produces adjustment entries + billing alerts. Console should surface those reconciliation candidates.

anika: Telemetry: emit provisional_orphan_ratio and confirm_merge_failures per-route. Quick query to find suspects:
```sql
SELECT route, count(*) AS orphaned_provisionals
FROM ledger_entries
WHERE type='provisional' AND confirmed_ref IS NULL AND created_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY orphaned_provisionals DESC;
```

morgan: Rollout plan: 1) add x-origin-id to client SDK behind flag 2) create index concurrently 3) deploy confirm-merge behind feature flag to 10% canary 4) run reconciliation sweep and credit affected tenants 5) flip. Fallback behavior if header missing.

tara: Tests: unit for truncation+retry ordering, integration sim for KV eviction mid-stream, and billing smoke on canary orgs. Also add a chaos test for broker restarts during confirm.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: confirm-merge-ff -> canary in 30m :gear:

morgan: I'll open the RFC + console mock and coordinate with DB for the index window. Will ping when RFC is up. :thumbsup:
